name: Vigil arsenal: VW2 detailed weapon set
registry: tools/arsenal.py WEAPONS2 (VW2-01..16); tools/armory.py VW/VA left unchanged
frame: mm at print scale; x to the muzzle, z up, origin = main grip / fist centre (knife and breaching tool: grip along z; grenade and charge: base at z = 0)

hand_fit.note: same block as VW-01..07, so exosuit.fist() closes over it; FORE in tools/arsenal.py gives the support-hand point

detail_rules_mm.grip_texture: finger grooves r 0.24 mm (0.48 wide), side grooves 0.46 x 0.18 mm
detail_rules_mm.near_bodies: two bodies either fuse (smooth union k 0.12-0.25, or overlap) or clear each other by > 0.46 mm
detail_rules_mm.measured_by: unified-CAD-MCP miniature_detail_resolution_check: 0 fills on every part

exaggerations: barrels 1.0-1.4 mm (true 1:56 bore/barrel would be 0.3-0.5 mm)
panel lines 0.5 mm V-grooves (true 6 mm seams would be 0.1 mm)
rail teeth 0.45 mm on a 1.0 mm pitch (true picatinny 5.2 mm pitch would be 0.09 mm)
knife blade 1.0 mm thick at the spine, edge a 0.4 mm rounded flat (no knife edge)
grips sized to the Vigil gauntlet (1.0 x 1.1 mm), not to a scaled human hand

catalog.revision_note: VW2 series 0.2: 16 detailed weapons with measured fine detail, bolted plates and signature hardware (printability not yet passing)
catalog.description: Second-generation Vigilant weapons, much more detailed than VW-01..08: VW2-01 Glaive service rifle (rail laser), VW2-02 Quarrel carbine, VW2-03 Bodkin marksman rifle (scope sunshade, bipod), VW2-04 Ranseur grenadier rifle, VW2-05 Thresher drum shotgun, VW2-06 Rondel PDW, VW2-07 Culverin heavy revolver (charge cell), VW2-08 Awl service pistol (rail light), VW2-09 Partisan LMG, VW2-10 Arbalest rail rifle (coil windings, charge lenses), VW2-11 Censer plasma projector (sight-glass), VW2-12 Ballista launcher (strakes, fire-control box, carry handle), VW2-13 Misericorde combat knife, VW2-14 Crowbill breaching tool, VW2-15 Cinder grenade, VW2-16 Petard breaching charge. 0.5 mm V-groove panel lines, 0.46 mm vents with 0.45 mm lands, bolted access plates, bolt carriers in the ejection ports, round-count studs, cooling rings and lenses. Fine detail measured with unified-CAD-MCP miniature_detail_resolution_check; printability not yet passing (thin walls on every part, a few recesses still fill in: see the printability report).
buildNotes: Defined in tools/arsenal.py (WEAPONS2 registry, VW2-01..16); built by tools/bitspack.py on a 0.05 mm SDF grid; display sheets by source/sheet.py.
Every pistol grip is the VW grip block (1.0 x 1.1 x 2.0 mm at the origin), so figures hold VW2 weapons with the existing gauntlets.

0.2: panel lines are 0.5 mm 90-degree V-grooves, vents 0.46 mm with 0.45 mm lands, rail teeth 0.45 mm with 0.55 mm gaps; raised plates, bolts, lenses and cooling rings carry most of the new detail (raised detail needs only 0.1 mm).
Measured with unified-CAD-MCP miniature_detail_resolution_check (new in this revision): 0 recesses fill in on any part; see reports/printability.md and DESIGN-LOG.md.
catalog.limitations: Procedural designs; printability and detail are heuristic screens (unified-CAD-MCP), not a test print. Print meshes are simplified by manifold3d only as far as the 280k-triangle check budget needs (tolerance in reports/build.json). The assembly STEP is an envelope reference re-meshed at 0.35 mm (about 1,000-1,600 triangles per weapon): it does not carry the fine detail; the print STLs do.
